steps.content: With the help of Stargazer, you easily track down the remaining desert bandits.
—The bunch of feral stragglers who have mutated beyond human recognition. One of these creatures is slicing open its companion's belly in a vain attempt to hide the Ash Crystal.
Bloody innards spill all over the ground, intermingling with the eerie red glow of the crystal.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: These are the humans you trust...
Stargazer spits out these words to no one in particular, picks up the soggy Ash Crystal and tosses it into your hands.
All the desert bandit remnants have been caught, and the crystal is back in your hands. Now it's time to face the consequences...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, the Outland Affairs Bureau has issued an urgent communications request.
Your previous actions must have greatly offended the Outland Affairs Bureau. You must address them properly.
After you assign Hecate to interrogate the desert bandits, you rush to the cockpit.
Since you successfully recovered two Ash Crystals and wiped out all the desert bandits, the Outland Affairs Bureau could only verbally admonish you for your unauthorized actions.
After you hang up the comms, Hecate walks into the cockpit. It seems the interrogation has made some findings.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, this is the desert bandits' interrogation record.

Hecate turns on the security footage and begins to replay the interrogation. You see the desert bandits, now deprived of the Ash Crystal, begging for mercy under the pressure of Hecate's Nightmare, spewing out everything they know.
You catch a key term in their jumble of words, Filthflower.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: The desert bandit said that their crystal came from a creature trapped in the depths of the Tide of Ashes called the "Filthflower."

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: When the desert bandits attained the crystal, they not only gained the power to control sandworms, but also used it to summon the Tide of Ashes.
There are living creatures in the depths of the Tide of Ashes?
You try to recall the scene around you inside the Tide of Ashes, but you can't remember anything other than the oppressive and suffocating Apostles of Ashes.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: It's... the source of the Tide of Ashes.
Stargazer, who has been silent all this time, comes up to you and gently swipes the screen, replaying one of the desert bandits' "confession."

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: It's the place where the Apostles of Ashes want to take you.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: No one knows what that place is, nor does anyone know what the Filthflower and its intentions are.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: But if it's the source of the Tide of Ashes, then I guess we'll have to make the trip.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Well, theoretically, if you find the “Filthflower”, you may find a way to end the Tide of Ashes.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: WhiteSands... will regain its tranquility.
With the disclosure of information about the Ash Crystal, the conspiracy of the rampaging desert bandits has finally been unveiled. It is time for you to embark on a new journey.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hey you workaholics, are you done with the report yet?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hecate, I told you to bring ${PlayerName} over to the celebratory party as soon as you drop off the record, but I waited all day and neither of you came back!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Yes, the shelter arranged it... to show their gratitude.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Let's go already! Kawa-kawa is already there!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Here's to our adventure! Cheers!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hey, why are you being such a party pooper? It's time to wine and dine and party all night! Right, Kawa-kawa?

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: Yes... mmmm... This is delicious! Another one, please!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Yuck! Swallow before you talk!

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: Hehe, I just feel so happy to have met you guys and joined in the mission!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Uhhhh... so corny... are you babbling nonsense because you're drunk? Who would be happy to meet a Sinner?

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: I didn't drink. These are my true feelings.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: We even found new Ash Crystals! Maybe we'll be able to break through the Tide of Ashes and chart a perfect WhiteSands route.
The bonfire burns brightly, illuminating Kawa-kawa's blushing face and bright eyes.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: Of course, it's all thanks to Chief and Miss Stargazer!

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: Ah... what a pity that she did not come to the party. I still have a lot of questions for her...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Maybe Miss Stargazer didn't come because she doesn't want to be pestered by you.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: Am I really that annoying? Sob... I'm sorry.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Yes. Chief, do you want to take her along for tomorrow's operation?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: The decision is really up to her. You guys continue. I'll go find her.
You stand up to leave the celebratory party.
You want to find Stargazer, but you realize after leaving the noisy party that you don't know where she is.

The huge full moon glows brightly in the night sky. For some reason, you remember the recurring dream you had countless times before, where you follow the full moon forward step by step, just like you're doing now.
Ting-a-ling... ting-a-ling...
The crisp clinking of metal arises from behind a low sand dune.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Hmm? Is someone there?

Under the full moon, Stargazer is dancing.
...No, it is not simply a dance.
It is... a language. You've never witnessed it before, but you're sure of it.
As she turns to you with her strange dance steps, you see that her eyes are gently closed, immersed in some kind of silent music.
You are awestruck by this earnest and pious side of the mysterious and inscrutable Stargazer.
You hold your breath, but she still senses you.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: You came?

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: To ask me to stay.
She's not posing a rhetorical question. She has simply read your mind.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: You asked a strange question. Let me answer you this way... I know everything about you.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: I already completed your requests. I should be leaving anyways.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Why are you asking me to stay?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You're also a Sinner.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: So? You want to arrest me?

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: I never hid anything about myself from you. Yet you've been feeding me lies all this time. You keep more secrets than anyone.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I'm sorry, considering the mission back then...

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: No need to apologize. It's up to you to decide who to share your true self with.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Let me reintroduce myself. I am the Chief of the Minos Bureau of Crisis Control. I have the power of "Shackles," which... is similar to the power of Ash Crystals, and can inhibit Sinner's Mania.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I hope that I can help you curb your Mania, and that you can continue to accept my requests, and use the power of the crystal to help us find the location of this mysterious lifeform.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: You didn't answer my question, Chief.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Why do you insist that I stay? Just because of... the mission?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You asked me before...

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Dreams are the projection of reality. You are indeed special, and beloved by WhiteSands.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: ...Though you are beloved by WhiteSands, will you choose it in return? Will you leave the human world?
Your decision is...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I will not give up WhiteSands.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You says it loves me, then more the reason for me to explore its deepest secrets.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I want to know why it made me have such a dream?
Stargazer chuckles. Her voice is cold and crisp, like the metal sequins of her skirt clinking against each other under the pale moonlight.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Even if this leads you to danger and deception, to a path of no return, or even death...?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Even so.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: You are indeed... unique. I knew that from the moment I set eyes on you.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Words are like quicksand, slipping through one's fingers.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: I hid the diamond between the sands, yet you are blind to it.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: It's about the truth... regarding you and me.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: You and I, we are both "others" in this world. Monsters.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Isn't it lonely to exclude yourself from everyone else?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Perhaps I understand why you linger in WhiteSands. The world beyond WhiteSands is filled with humans blinded to the truth. They make you take the journey alone.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: But you still have companions in this world.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: It's like the dream I had about WhiteSands. I could sense its sadness, so I wanted to understand it, and discover the source of its melancholy.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Hence, even if we are in different worlds, our mutual understanding and compassion is genuine.
The moon cloaks Stargazer's face in misty moonlight, blurring her expression from you.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: From the day I became aware of my power, to the day I was condemned as a heretic, till now, I have never felt alone.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: No, the power of prophecy. Divining for others has a special meaning for me.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: It was the first time I encountered that world, and felt "its" power. "It" allowed me to see... the omen.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: I became obsessed, intent on using the omens to catch a glimpse of the end of the world.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Back in reality, everything I prophesied came true one by one. For a while, I became a deity in everyone's eyes.
Stargazer tilts her head. The pale light cascades into her eyes, fusing into glimmers of sadness.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: But more than admiration, humans feared this power... My people treated me as a deviant in league with the devil. I was constantly shunned and chased away.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: I became a monster to the world... From then on, I've been wading against the crowd in pursuit of the truth that belongs to me. I've also been waiting... for my true companion.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: The crystal ball told me that the answers to my questions lie inside the Tide of Ashes. So I left my people and ventured into the Tide of Ashes alone.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Yes. I almost died in that sandstorm. "It," who hails from the "other world," saved me, and bestowed me... an eternal life of a different kind.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: I finally felt the kindness of a "companion."

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: I will never forget the kindness from my "companion." Thus I'm certain, that even if separated by language and thought, there are more of my kind in this world.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Thank you for choosing to understand me no matter what. It makes me very happy... so, I choose to help you again.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: You little monster who wants to understand monsters.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Ah, look. The full moon has risen to the middle of the sky.
<color=white>The moonlight blankets the desert in a dream-like hue.</color>
<color=white>Stargazer dances amidst this "dream."</color>
<color=white>No one wants to shift their gaze.</color>
<color=white>She dances so movingly.</color>
<color=white>Such beauty can only be expressed by someone who believes in "dreams."</color>
The next day, you command the V-710 to leave the shelter and head for the Tide of Ashes.
The closer you get to that gloomy black tempest, the heavier everyone's breathing becomes. Everyone instinctively wants to avoid that place... that unknown, horrific realm of death.
Everyone except Stargazer.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, the Tide of Ashes is ahead.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: I... I have the crystals ready...

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: Go, Chief, go! I... I believe we can do it!
You nod towards everyone and hand the two crystals to Stargazer once more.
Stargazer takes the crystals and leaps lightly onto the bow railing, perching on her toes.
She holds the crystals in her hands, letting the sand lash her hair and clothes...

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Chief... go and experience that dangerous path you're determined to take.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: What do you m—
The howling sandstorm suddenly strengthens, and you struggle to keep your eyes open. Amidst the dust shrouding the sky, you suddenly perceive something...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Hecate! Hella!
The wind subsides, and the dust disperses. Stargazer has long disappeared from the bow railing. In front of the sand ship are several sandworms with gaping mouths.
